kangaroo-ca-2023-g0708-14.title: Half the parallelogram
kangaroo-ca-2023-g0708-14.body:
Call the point on the top side where the lines meet $P$. The white triangle has the whole bottom side as its base and $P$ on the opposite side, so its height is the height of the parallelogram: its area is half the parallelogram, 150 cm².

The rest, 150 cm², is made of the dotted triangle (40) and the big triangle on the left formed by the left side and $P$ (hatched + black). So hatched + black = 150 − 40 = 110, and black = 110 − 100 = 10 cm².

**Answer: (A) 10**

kangaroo-ca-2023-g0708-21.title: Odd plus even
kangaroo-ca-2023-g0708-21.body:
Each sum is odd, so each roll shows one odd and one even number. The odd number $k$ is in all three rolls, so the even partners are $5 - k$, $7 - k$ and $9 - k$, all between 1 and 6.

- $k = 1$: partners 4, 6, 8 — but 8 is impossible.
- $k = 5$: partners 0, 2, 4 — 0 is impossible.
- $k = 3$: partners 2, 4, 6. ✓

The rolls were (3, 2), (3, 4), (3, 6). Of the options only (2, 3) appears.

**Answer: (C) (2, 3)**

kangaroo-ca-2023-g0708-28.title: Angles around a point
kangaroo-ca-2023-g0708-28.body:
In the centre 10 thin rhombuses meet, so each has an angle of $360° \div 10 = 36°$ there; its other angles are 144°, 36° and 144°.

Look at the end of a side shared by two neighbouring thin rhombuses (away from the centre). Both thin rhombuses have a 144° angle there, which leaves $360° - 2\cdot144° = 72°$ for the big white rhombus that fills the gap. A rhombus with a 72° angle has angles 72° and $180° - 72° = 108°$.

**Answer: (B) 108°**

kangaroo-ca-2023-g0708-29.title: Fraction of the half-day
kangaroo-ca-2023-g0708-29.body:
8:25 in new time is 8 new hours and 25 new minutes, i.e. $8.25$ new hours, which is $\frac{8.25}{10} = 0.825$ of the half-day. In ordinary time that is $0.825 \cdot 12 = 9.9$ hours = 9 hours 54 minutes.

**Answer: (E) 9:54**

kangaroo-ca-2023-g0708-29.title: Convert minutes
kangaroo-ca-2023-g0708-29.body:
Half a day has $12 \cdot 60 = 720$ ordinary minutes and $10 \cdot 100 = 1000$ new minutes, so one new minute is 0.72 ordinary minutes. 8:25 is 825 new minutes $= 825 \cdot 0.72 = 594$ ordinary minutes = 9 h 54 min.

**Answer: (E) 9:54**
